paragraphs: Intangles sells an AI-powered platform meant to predict vehicle breakdowns days before they happen and to reduce fuel costs for fleet operators. Fleet staff get real-time data on every vehicle, including causes, symptoms, and repair strategies.

The company says the system identifies issues long before a vehicle's diagnostic trouble codes are triggered. Its patented algorithms draw on sensors the manufacturer already installed rather than new hardware for that purpose. Coverage extends to diesel exhaust fluid monitoring, which the company ties to emissions compliance. Service tasks can be scheduled, tracked and managed in the same platform. The company claims a 95% accuracy rate in real-world scenarios for forecasting component-level failures.

Published case studies include work with a regional transit fleet in California. Another describes a waste management company in the United States that operates a large fleet of refuse trucks. A third covers a North American owner of 100 long-haul diesel freight trucks built by six different manufacturers.
